judgment_text:
PETITION filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India to issue an order or orders or directions or writ in the nature of writ of Habeas Corpus and direct the respondent to produce the petitioners daughter detenue Allima Malar D/o. Arivudainambi aged about 20 years before this Hon'ble Court and set her liberty and pass such other order or orders of this Hon'ble Court deemed fit and proper in the circumstances of the case.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— Mr R. Muniyapparaj, learned Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by Mr M. Sylvester John, learned counsel accepts notice for the respondents.

2. An endorsement is made by Mr K. Rajamohan, learned counsel on record for the petitioner to the effect that the petitioner does not pursue this petition, since the detenue Ms Allima Malar, aged 20 years has been secured and handed over to the petitioner.

3. Recording the endorsement made, this Habeas Corpus Petition is closed.
